description: Only when the user wants something that needs their UpFork account: saying a lesson worked or didn't, their account, installing a product that isn't free, a product's AI prompt, support tickets, their profile and résumé, articles, lesson drafts or team lessons. Ask the user first. Their AI app then opens upfork.dev for them to sign in (in Claude Code: /mcp, choose upfork, Authenticate) and connects again with the tools for those. Everything else here works without it.
